{{Infobox auto}}

'''Green curry''' is one of the oven meals. It heals {{Hp|20}} and grants {{EffectLink|Speed}} II for 30 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/green_curry.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
A [[Green Curry Stock|green curry stock]] cooks into green curry in 15 seconds in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]]. Obtaining the stock unlocks the recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating it takes 3 seconds, heals {{Hp|20}} and gives Speed II (+40% speed) for 30:00. The bowl is given back.

=== Trading ===
{{Upcoming|type=section}}
It is one of the foods a villager will be able to ask for as its [[favorite food]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/favorite_food/food_trades/food_36.mcfunction|at=5bf7c3e22adaabf2416c83b709842cb9a053cb95}}</ref>

== Advancements ==
* ''Too Spicy!'': make green curry (1 [[obol]]).

{{History|
